newsitem.title: USA: Microlytics named in Unterberg lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Microlytics named in Unterberg lawsuit.

text.p: Microlytics Inc said late Friday that it was named as a defendant in an legal action brought by Unterberg Harris Private Equity Partners LP in a U.S. federal court.

After the market closed, Microlytics said the suit, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, alleges fraud and breach of contract in connection with Unterberg's purchase of $2.5 million of the company's securities in June 1995.
The company said it has not yet had an opportunity to review either the complaint or the underlying facts in detail.
